[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes ans by scanning bits 61 down to 0: appends 1 at bits set in the XOR of all inputs, and at bits not set uses subset-XOR reachability to decide whether to keep appended bit patterns; returns ans + (ans ^ allxor)." solve]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> N </REF>: int "Number of elements in A."
        <REF> A </REF>: list of int "List of integers whose bits are processed."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "The computed value ans + (ans ^ allxor)."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set allxor to 0, then XOR every element a in A into allxor. RESULT allxor]
            [COMMAND Initialize B to a list of N zeros, ans to 0, and bcount to 0. RESULT B, ans, bcount]
            [COMMAND For bit from 61 down to 0 inclusive, set mask = 1 << bit. RESULT mask]
            [COMMAND Within the bit loop, if allxor & mask is nonzero, append a 1 bit to ans by setting ans = (ans << 1) | 1 and continue to the next bit without modifying B or bcount. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the bit loop, when allxor & mask is zero, for each i from 0 to N-1 append the current bit of A[i] to B[i] by setting B[i] = (B[i] << 1) | ((A[i] & mask) >> bit), and add each updated B[i] to bset. RESULT B, bset]
            [COMMAND After the B update, increment bcount and set full_bit = (1 << bcount) - 1. RESULT bcount, full_bit]
            [COMMAND Convert bset to a list blist, then split it into blist1 = blist[:len(blist)//2] and blist2 = blist[len(blist)//2:]; the split is arbitrary but the reachability result is independent of it. RESULT blist1, blist2]
            [COMMAND Compute r1 as the XOR-subset-closure of blist1 and r2 as the XOR-subset-closure of blist2: initialize each to {0}; for each b in blist1, add b ^ c to r1 for every c in a snapshot of r1; for each b in blist2, add b ^ c to r2 for every c in a snapshot of r2. RESULT r1, r2]
            [COMMAND Set best = full_bit - 1; scan r1 and on the first b1 for which (b1 ^ full_bit) is in r2, set best = full_bit and break. RESULT best]
            [COMMAND Set bestb = best & 1, then append this bit to ans by setting ans = (ans << 1) | bestb. RESULT bestb, ans]
            [COMMAND If bestb == 0, undo the B update by shifting every B[i] right by 1, and decrement bcount. RESULT B, bcount]
            [COMMAND Return ans + (ans ^ allxor). RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
